dragon.title: the
dragon.name: red dragon
death_messages: You get eaten by the dragon... hopefully you can have a better life as dragon poop.

text.on_hit: {atk.name} bite{atk.s} a good chunk out of {def.name}!
text.on_armor_save: {atk.name} spit{atk.s} {def.name} out after deciding {def.object} too hard to chew.

text.on_hit: {atk.name} grills {def.name} in a giant raging inferno!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} grills {def.name} in a giant raging inferno, leaving only a charred corpse!
text.on_dodge: {def.name} barely manage{def.s} to jump out of the fire's way!
text.on_armor_save: The raging inferno does not bother {def.name} at all.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} raise{atk.s} two of {atk.poss_adjective} front paws, ready to strike.
text.on_hit: {atk.name} swipes {atk.poss_adjective} claws at {def.name} and leaves a bloody trail!
text.on_dodge: {atk.name} strike{atk.s} at the ground, rather then {def.name}.
text.on_armor_save: {def.name} takes the full brunt of the attack, fully unfazed!
